title: Heat Reduces How Cyclists Use Carbohydrate
paragraphs: Many athletes drink sports drinks. These drinks give them sugar for energy. This sugar is called carbohydrate.
Scientists tested 17 cyclists. The cyclists rode a bike for 90 minutes. Some rides were in a very hot room, at 40 degrees.
In the hot room, the cyclists used less sugar from the drink. They used about 27 percent less. Heat practice did not help. The study was small.
